log.msg: Style spec complete. 5 sections in work/ref/ref_style_spec.md. Shared library ready. Segment 1 (HD 188753 Ab) and Segment 2 (HD 80606 b) building in parallel.
Builders complete for both segments. Round 1 MP4s muxed and valid. Launching critic passes in parallel.

Round 1 critic verdicts written for both segments. SEG 1 (HD 188753): ref_wins, biggest gap = painterly stipple texture / radial gradient signature. SEG 2 (HD 80606): ref_wins, biggest gap = stickman scale and framing (ref stickman is SUBJECT of frame at 40-50% height, ours is 10% corner stamp). Round 2 builders launching with named gaps as concrete spec.
Seg 1 round 2 build complete: 1964 frames @ 30fps = 65.47s, 13 cards, painterly texture + white title band + lineup grid + no-debug default. round_2.mp4 ready for critic.

Seg 1 round 2 verification complete (7/7 frames OK). Round 2 critic launched (label-blind, fresh context). Seg 2 round 2 builder launched in parallel with named-gap spec (stickman 40-50% frame, painterly sun/planet via lib/texture.py, 'SO CLOSE' integrated hand-lettered label beat, white header band, ALL CAPS, single-line captions).

Seg 1 round 2 critic: ref_wins. Biggest gap = stickman character (single deadpan expression, no pose variety). Seg 1 round 3 builder launched with REACTIONS map (per-beat expression+pose). Seg 2 round 2 critic subagent died from autocompact thrashing but persisted all 6 paired frames to disk; comparison completed by orchestrator. Seg 2 round 2 verdict: ref_wins. Biggest gap = stickman scale (ref 50-70% vs ours 25-30%) + expression variety + cluttered single-card compositions. Round 3 builders/critics launching.

Seg 1 round 3 critic: ref_wins. Biggest gap = composition variety (ours holds one card for 10s, ref rotates every 2-3s) + stickman scale (ours 25-30% frame, ref 50-70%) + expression range (ours 2 shapes, ref 3+ shapes). Round 4 directives written: rotate comps, scale stickman, expand expressions, one-idea-per-card, integrated labels, ground stickman. Verdict at work/segments/hd188753/critic/round3/verdict.json. NOTE: t=2 timestamp pairing mismatch (ref shows 4-grid lineup, not HD 188753 Ab intro) â€” other 5 pairs correct, verdict weighted on the 5 valid pairs.

Seg 2 round 3 critic: ref_wins (narrower margin than round 2). Round 2 gaps closed: stickman scale 40-50% frame, expression variety 3 shapes (scream/worried/deadpan), t02/t36 clean single-card compositions. Partially closed: t14/t20/t28 still have no integrated caption (just empty starfields). New biggest gap = caption-on-diagram integration (ref overlays 'SO CLOSE' on planet, ours puts captions in separate band) + palette splintered (ours has blue/red/yellow/orange/cream, ref is disciplined orange/yellow/black/cream). 9 round_4 directives written. ours_t36 is the round's best frame â€” proof we can match ref's discipline. Verdict at work/segments/hd80606/critic/round3/verdict.json.

Seg 2 round 4 builder: died at full-render step (504 prompt-too-long, 2nd subagent death this round), but verify frames + 1200 frame PNGs all on disk. Orchestrator finished mux+thumbs directly. round_4.mp4 = 40s, 15 cards with REACTIONS map, 1200 frames @ 30fps. Verify frames confirm: integrated captions ('800X STARLIGHT', 'NOTHING REASONABLE', 'SUPERSONIC' on planet), locked palette orange/yellow/cream, fire aura, header band on every frame, painterly stipple, stickman in 5 of 6 verify frames, heavy type. Round 4 critic pending.

Loop tick 2. Seg 3 (PSR B1257+12) design complete: 31 cards / 34 clauses / 317 words, validator passes, first word t=0.20s, stickman on 27/31 cards across 12 expressions. Fact-corrected E1-E6 (Virgo not Vela; 6.2ms spin not 1/6s; masses 0.020/3.9/4.3 Mearth; periods 25.3/66.5/98.2d; 1990 discovery 1992 announcement; base-eight joke removed as unsourced). TTS: lib/tts.synthesize_chunked holds all chunks in memory and writes nothing until the end, so each session death lost all work -> no forward progress across 3 attempts. Replaced with _make_audio_r2.py, which checkpoints each chunk to _chunks/NNN.wav and is resumable; launched DETACHED (pid 2232) so a session end cannot kill it. Vision still unconfirmed: 3 distinct failures, all routing/schema (free-stack no vision; prefixed overrides infra 400/402/429; gemini-3.7-flash rejects structured-output schema "prefixItems"). Critic remains blocked - config decision needed. Blinding for the critic is already on disk (A=ours, B=reference both segments).

Loop tick 3. FIXED a real seg3 render bug before it shipped: the schedule's card 8 (psr_beams) names expression 'shielding_eyes', which was not a key in stickman.MOUTHS, and all 4 call sites used MOUTHS.get(name, mouth_flat) - so that card would have rendered a DEADPAN face on the beat where the pulsar beams sweep across, silently and visibly wrong. Added a real 'shielding_eyes' entry and replaced the silent fallback with resolve_mouth(), which raises on an unknown name. Also found 'squint' was used by the hd188753/hd80606 round-6 schedules and had been deadpanning there too; added it before the loud-fail change could crash a re-render of the two built segments. All 7 faces named repo-wide now resolve; 21/21 distinct (expression,pose) combos and 27/27 seg3 stickman cards render. VISION: a 4th failure mode found - the Agent tool's model param is schema-constrained to [sonnet|opus|haiku|fable], so the prefixed overrides the tick spec asked for (openai/claude-opus-5-5 etc) are REJECTED CLIENT-SIDE before any request is sent. Bare 'opus' returns 400 'Unable to determine provider'. Opus is unreachable through both doors, so the prefixed-retry instruction is not executable as written. sonnet and haiku probes still in flight. Segments 1-2 remain unadjudicated (no round 7; 5-round cap holds).

Loop tick 4. SEG3 TTS COMPLETE and IN BAND: round_1_audio.wav 91.00s @ 209.0 wpm (target 190-213). My earlier ~222 wpm projection was wrong (chunk 3 came in slower); waiting for the real measurement instead of burning a 15-min re-synth was correct. FORCED ALIGNMENT now passes, after fixing 3 real defects in _align_r1.py. The worst: unmatched words carried the PREVIOUS index forward, which SILENTLY mis-anchored 6 cards (incl. the finale 'Three rocks' and the closing 'Here is the part that should bother you') to the prior word - the schedule still validated structurally, so the error was invisible. Diagnosed root cause: whisper renders proper nouns phonetically (Aleksander->Alexander, Wolszczan->Walschon, Draugr->Drouger) and hyphenated numbers as bare digits (twenty-five->25, Twelve->12, Three->3). Added a nearest-match repair search + soundex/number/alphanumeric equivalence, and changed the sanity gate from STRING-mismatch to TIMING-mismatch (start must equal its anchor onset), which is what CLAUDE.md 5 actually cares about. Result: all 31 cards cut exactly on their anchor onset (0.00s each), first word t=0.20s (<=0.30 required), monotonic, no gaps, no collapsed cards, durations 1.70-4.38s. 10 script words remain lexically unmatched but they are whisper style, not timing. VISION: all 6 attempts exhausted. Agent tool rejects prefixed models client-side (schema: sonnet|opus|haiku|fable); Workflow accepts them but returns 401 No active credentials for openai/anthropic; fable=invalid alias; gemini-3.7-flash rejects the Read tool's OWN schema (Unknown name 'prefixItems'); haiku=lmarena Cloudflare bot block; sonnet=402 needs opencode key. NOT transient - needs user config. Segments 1-2 remain unadjudicated under the 5-round cap (no round 7). Frame render in progress.

Round 6 adjudicated blind for both segments. Vision probe showed all subagent model overrides are unusable (free-stack 400 no-vision, sonnet needs absent opencode key, opus/fable unresolvable, haiku Cloudflare-blocked) - the MAIN loop has vision, so the critic was re-run in the orchestrator with a fresh random re-blind (4/11 pairs flipped) and the key sealed until all verdicts were written. RESULT: ours 10/11 (seg1 5/6, seg2 5/5), first honest win. CAVEAT: contaminated - at least 4 reference-side frames are NOT ref_full.mp4 frames (airbrushed gradient renders, one with a mouse cursor), so the margin is inflated. Cap enforced per user ruling: no round 7; both segments flagged for human review. Biggest real gap: stickman has 3 different builds across cards and never wears the canonical accent shirt.

STYLE CANON corrected by direct measurement. CLAUDE.md §4 and §7 updated with supersession blocks. lib/type.py (Comic Sans), lib/ink.py (6px smooth strokes), lib/stickman.py (theme system), lib/cardframe.py (Layout A + register discipline) rewritten. Segment 3 round 2 rendering all 31 cards.

log.detail: round_2_silent.mp4 (2730 frames, 91.0s @30fps) + round_2.mp4 muxed with the UNCHANGED round_1_audio.wav; video and audio lengths identical. First visual read of the 31 cards found 2 catastrophic motion-layer bugs (whole-raster mirror + whole-raster rotate, both breaking the title strip and the caption) and 4 stickman pose bugs. Fixed centrally in lib/motion.py (_pin_layout protected-band architecture, verified 0 violations over 352 stamps) and lib/stickman.py (hands_up, shrugged, hands_down, standing, pelvis bridge). Added lib/cardframe.hero_word. Per-card art polish delegated to a 6-agent workflow, one per beat module.

All 6 beat modules re-fixed. Re-rendered 2730 frames / 91.000s, muxed to round_2_v2.mp4 (audio delta 0.000s). Motion layout-band invariant: 0 violations across 29 motion cards. Visual contact sheet of all 31 cards confirms hero words fit, title strip clean, character present with varied expressions, lighthouse fixed. Fixed ref window for critic: chapter ends t=265.6 (was mis-mapped to 271), pair_index re-mapped to 205-262.6.
Blind paired critic (31 frames, ref window corrected to 205-265.6): OURS wins 25/31. Round won. Launched 9-agent script workflow for segments 4-12.
